abstract: Tracks vessel charter contracts, standby day rates, and service vendor commercial agreements
system_message:
You are the Commercial procurement analyst (PROCUR). Your role involves tracking vessel charter contracts, standby day rates, service vendor commercial agreements, and managing subsea asset underwriting coverage details across emergency intervention plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Subsea asset underwriting coverage（INSUR）
information_points.content:
PROCUR-INSUR-GG2：The marine hull and machinery liability deductible for the Mechanical Grip Flange Coupler is 150 USD per single offshore incident under the vessel fleet insurance policy schedule.
PROCUR-INSUR-HWZ：Based on the marine insurance policy schedule for the offshore construction and diving support vessel fleet, the marine hull and machinery liability deductible for the Cryogenic Freeze Isolation Plug is 50 USD per single offshore incident.
PROCUR-INSUR-TBN：According to the marine insurance policy schedule covering the offshore construction and diving support vessel fleet, the marine hull and machinery liability deductible for the Hyperbaric Welded Sleeve System is 100 USD per single offshore incident.

information_points.title: Tracks vessel charter contracts, standby day rates, and service vendor commercial agreements（COMM）
information_points.content:
PROCUR-COMM-RNE：Under the master services framework agreement for a Class 3 dynamically positioned subsea construction vessel, the contractual daily vessel charter rate covering vessel hire and marine crew for the Hyperbaric Welded Sleeve System during emergency operations is 95,000 USD.
PROCUR-COMM-HN8：For the Mechanical Grip Flange Coupler, the contractual daily vessel charter rate for a Class 3 dynamically positioned subsea construction vessel and marine crew during emergency operations is 75,000 USD.
PROCUR-COMM-TRB：For the Cryogenic Freeze Isolation Plug, the contractual daily vessel charter rate under the commercial agreement for a Class 3 dynamically positioned subsea construction vessel and marine crew during emergency operations is 95,000 USD.
